consoleErrors: Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 404 (Not Found)
runs.notes: The 404 is the existing fixture/static-resource noise captured by the harness; no task-origin request failed and the required shell assertions passed. Chrome certificate bypass was scoped to this task-owned launch/context only. Temporary certificate and key were removed after the run.

runs.name: Secure loopback HTTP fallback
consoleErrors: Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 404 (Not Found)
runs.notes: Chromium treats loopback HTTP as a trustworthy secure context; this fallback supplements the HTTPS run and is not a claim about arbitrary insecure HTTP origins.

runs.name: Frozen implementation regression
runs.command: Fixture build with frozen hostname-gated src/main.ts followed by verify-offline-shell.mjs on non-localhost 127.0.0.1
runs.notes: This reproduces the requested defect: the frozen localhost-only gate prevents registration on the non-localhost origin.

criteria.criterion: Default production build enables the worker without local opt-in.
criteria.evidence: Default and clean fixture production builds exit 0; compiled fixture diagnostics report SW build flag true.

criteria.criterion: Non-localhost secure origin installs an active controller and caches all generated shell assets with BASE_URL scope.
criteria.evidence: HTTPS 127.0.0.1 runtime reports secure context, activated registration/controller and precache 7/7; observed root BASE_URL scope is the origin root. Registration code derives URL and scope from import.meta.env.BASE_URL.

criteria.criterion: Stopping the task-owned server and reloading offline renders the Today shell and offline state from the saved fixture snapshot.
criteria.evidence: Both runtime runs stop their own static server, reload offline and observe appChildren 2, offline badge true and Today rows true; TodayScreen keeps the check-in action disabled while offline.

criteria.criterion: API/token traffic and non-GET mutations remain outside the app-shell worker cache.
criteria.evidence: public/sw.js was unchanged and node --check exits 0; existing same-origin GET-only, /api/ bypass and non-GET bypass paths remain intact.

criteria.criterion: Development has no production-worker install path and removes only this app's stale root registration.
criteria.evidence: main.ts gates registration on compiled production flag plus isSecureContext and scopes DEV cleanup by exact BASE_URL scope and sw.js scriptURL; PWA lint/typecheck pass.

criteria.criterion: The changed verifier fails the frozen implementation and passes after FIX-r2.
criteria.evidence: Frozen source run exits 1 at controller wait; corrected HTTPS and loopback runs exit 0.

limitations: The runtime uses fixture transport and a task-owned static server; live auth/BFF/backend integration remains outside this frontend lane.
HTTPS trust was limited to the task-owned browser launch/context; no CA, hosts, firewall, public tunnel or deployment changes were made.
The standalone preview uses BASE_URL '/'; non-root deployment remains covered by the BASE_URL-derived registration code and verifier mapping but was not a separate runtime run.
The captured 404 console line was not linked to this request and did not fail a task-origin request, so no unrelated static-resource change was made.
